rev.t: Canopy restaurant offers delicious food with a beautiful old-time nostalgic vibe. Being here brought back so many memories, and it felt truly special to sit at the same place with my daughter, along with my mother and mother-in-law. A heartfelt experience filled with warmth, memories, and great food.
Attended a wedding last week, food is amazing, venue centrally located, ample parking space. My pictures will tell you the rest.
